packages.title: Packages
packages.description: Package names to check. Prefix with an ecosystem to mix them in one run — npm:express, pypi:requests, crates:serde. Unprefixed names use the default ecosystem below.

ecosystem.title: Default ecosystem
ecosystem.description: Used for any package name without an ecosystem prefix.

includeDependencies.title: Include dependency graph
includeDependencies.description: Adds direct, transitive and deprecated dependency counts from deps.dev. Costs one extra upstream call per package, so runs take longer.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Packages fetched in parallel. Higher is faster but heavier on the public registries this reads from.
